# Lighthouse Keeper (test fixture)

A deliberately small Roblox game used to test Roblox Apex against real code. It contains **intentional,
realistic flaws**. Don't ship it.

Concept: co-op players keep a lighthouse lamp burning through a storm night by collecting oil cans and
refueling the lamp (press E). If the lamp goes dark, the night gets dangerous (not implemented yet).

Build a place file: `rojo build default.project.json -o LighthouseKeeper.rbxl` (or `rojo serve`).
